every branch pays one RESET plus one prefix replay; nothing is forked and no snapshot ABI is added - a branch is reconstructable from the saved prefix masks (run-length encoded) plus the verified state HASH

the candidate first action is applied for exactly DECISION_FRAMES=2 frames before the fixed teacher takes over, so 'the value of this first action' means 'under this continuation', never an unconditional Q value
unknown never becomes engine_death and never joins a safe set; a geometric tie never joins a safe set either

summary.tie_policy: a geometric score tie is recorded but never converted into a safe set: only a verified engine outcome enters one, and the tie states are reported separately so a reader can see what the tie did
summary.all_safe_policy: a state whose 18 candidates all survived is usable as ordinary BC data but carries no 'which action is dangerous' information; it is counted in all_candidates_safe and excluded from proper_safe_sets
summary.incomplete_policy: a state with an empty safe set, an incomplete branch list or a failed continuation is never padded into a positive example; its reason is recorded in the per-state rows and in unknown_reasons
